title: docs(skills): the console guide names the resolver `/` actually has (objectui#10140)
body:
Fixes #10140

One governed file, two rows lowered, net 0 lines (518 before, 518 after). **Draft on purpose**: `.claude/**` is on this repository's governed register, so this pull request stays draft and the claiming seat lands it after an authorized approval. Not flipped ready, no auto-merge armed. `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the one changed path prints `GOVERNED - 1 of 1 path(s)`, row `.claude/** x1`, exit 3.

## The two sites

The route-tree diagram, the root row:

```diff
-                  └── /                                      → ConnectedShell + RootRedirect
+                  └── /                                      → ProtectedRoute + RootLandingRedirect
```

The importable building-blocks list:

```diff
-`ConsoleShell`, `ConnectedShell`, `AuthenticatedRoute`, `RootRedirect`, `SystemRedirect`,
+`ConsoleShell`, `ConnectedShell`, `AuthenticatedRoute`, `SystemRedirect`,
```

## Why those two names

`apps/console/src/App.tsx` mounts the root route as `ProtectedRoute` (with `requireOrganization` false) around `RootLandingRedirect`. `ProtectedRoute` is the Console's own wrapper — its own doc comment calls it the replacement for app-shell's `AuthenticatedRoute` — and it is what mounts `ConnectedShell`. So the old row named an inner layer and the wrong leaf at the same time.

Two different merges made that row false, and only the second one is this card's:

- objectui#4042 put the root route behind `ProtectedRoute`. The pin that renders that shape is `RootLandingRedirect.route.test.tsx`, whose header describes what it mounts as "the REAL `/` route element — `ProtectedRoute` … wrapping the real `RootLandingRedirect`". From then on the diagram row was merely stale.
- objectui#10042 / PR #10103 (REST reports `merged` true, `merged_at` 2026-09-20T14:12:36Z) deleted `RootRedirect` from `packages/app-shell/src/console/ConsoleShell.tsx` and its one line from the barrel. That is what turned a stale row into an import list that does not compile.

`RootLandingRedirect` lives in `apps/console/src/components/`, so it is deliberately **not** added to the building-blocks list — that list is scoped to what `@object-ui/app-shell` exports, and `AppContent` one row above already sets the precedent for a Console-local name appearing in the diagram and not in the list.

Method, so those tick marks are re-derivable rather than asserted: TypeScript's own parser (`ts.createSourceFile`) over the barrel's export declarations, with a refusal path — the script exits 3 instead of answering if the barrel ever grows an `export *` re-export, because a syntactic read cannot enumerate one. It also reads the claimed names out of the guide itself (every backtick span under the "Key building blocks" anchor), so it cannot drift from the list it judges.

| `packages/app-shell/dist/index.d.ts` (what the package's `exports` publishes, after a real build) | 237 | 9 | 0 |

Absence control on both faces, with a positive control beside it so a zero is a reading and not a failed grep: `RootRedirect` 0 and 0 hits, `ConnectedShell` 1 and 1.

The script is a one-shot measurement kept in the run's scratchpad and deliberately **not** added to the tree — the card rules a new gate out of scope, and this repository's own floor is that a new gate is a maintainer decision.

## Does a gate already do this check? No.

Measured rather than recalled, over the gates that could plausibly reach it:

| gate | reaches `.claude/skills/**`? | judges symbol names against a barrel? |

| `check:skills-paths` | yes — its `SCAN_ROOTS` is `['skills', '.claude/skills']`, and its own header names this very guide | no — it judges in-repo PATHS stated in prose code spans. `RootRedirect` opens with none of its path prefixes, so it was never a candidate |
| `check:skill-examples` | yes — the same two roots | no — it judges opt-in-MARKED `ts` / `tsx` / `typescript` / `json` fences. Re-derived count of that marker string under `.claude/skills/**`: 0 (under `skills/**`: 88, and the marker is findable inside the gate itself, so the zero is a reading). The root-route diagram is an UNTAGGED fence and the building-blocks list is prose, so neither is even a candidate |
| `check:skill-eval-tokens` | no — its `SCAN_ROOTS` is `['skills']` only, stated as a decision in its header | not applicable |
| `check:readme-exports` | no — its surface is each package's own `README.md` | it does judge import names against real exports, which makes it the closest instrument in the tree — just not over this surface |
| `check:doc-component-types`, `check:doc-snippet-types`, `check:doc-fence-languages` | no — `DOCS_ROOT` is `content/docs` | not applicable |

So nothing in this repository would have caught this one, and nothing will catch the next one. Recorded here rather than closed here, exactly as the card directs.

## Acceptance notes

- Scope held: one file, two lines. The two pending changesets that also narrate `RootRedirect`, and `ROADMAP.md`'s historical checkbox, are untouched exactly as the card directs.
- The mechanical check covers the building-blocks list only. Other backticked symbol names elsewhere in this guide are checked by it and by nothing else either — recorded as an observation, not filed.
- Correction to the dispatch's concurrency scan: `git ls-remote --heads origin` filtered on `console-development` is NOT empty — it returns four `copilot/complete-*` branches carrying that phrase. None of them has an open pull request and none is an issue-10140 claim, so the conclusion (no concurrent work on this file) stands; the premise as stated did not.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** —— 内部贡献者指南 `.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/console-development.md` 的两行:路由图里根路由那一行,和「可从 `@object-ui/app-shell` 导入的积木」清单那一行。合计 2 增 2 删,文件行数 518 → 518,没有新增任何门禁、脚本或测试。

**为什么改** —— 这份指南是 agent 动手写代码之前读的输入。PR #10103 把 `RootRedirect` 从 `@object-ui/app-shell` 删掉了,清单却还在把它当成可导入的名字:照抄这份清单编译不过。路由图那一行错得更早 —— objectui#4042 上个月就把根路由换成了 Console 自己的 `ProtectedRoute` 包着 `RootLandingRedirect`。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** —— 风险接近于零:纯文档、不发版、不碰任何运行时代码。真正的代价是本次没有留下防复发的机械手段 —— 卡片明确不许在这里新加门禁,所以下一次同类漂移依然没有任何东西会拦住它。回滚就是 revert 这一个 commit,没有任何东西依赖它。

**席位意见** —— **建议:批准并由席位落地。** 一个受管文件两行、净 0 行:路由树根行改成 `apps/console/src/App.tsx` :404–:408 实际挂的 `ProtectedRoute + RootLandingRedirect`(席位在复核工作树上读到同一处;`ProtectedRoute.tsx` 自述替代 `AuthenticatedRoute`、内部挂 `ConnectedShell`),可导入清单删掉 barrel 里已不存在的 `RootRedirect`。清单剩余九个名字全部在 `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` 里解析得到(dev 用 TypeScript 解析器机械核对,改前 exit 1、改后 exit 0,src 与构建后的 dist 一致;席位复读)。卡片明令不加门禁,本 PR 没加。

**要你拍板的一件事(不阻塞本 PR):** 树里没有任何门禁把 `.claude/skills/**` 散文里的符号名和它声称的导出方比对(`check:skills-paths` 只看路径,`check:skill-examples` 只看打标的代码块,`check:readme-exports` 只看包 README)。要不要为「指南里的符号名」立一道门禁,是维护者层的决定;席位按「新增门禁默认否」不建议,记在此供你定夺。

**你要做的** —— 这是受管面 PR,按规程停在 draft。需要 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 留一条 APPROVED review,之后由认领席翻 ready 并入队。另外请拍一个板:「指南里的符号名对不对」要不要一道门禁来守?那是一个独立决定,本 PR 按卡片要求没有做,上面那张表把现有门禁为什么都够不着写清楚了。
